description: Cross-language validation cases for share payload 1.0 (contracts/schemas/share-payload-v1.schema.json). Validators must accept every valid case and, for each invalid case, report at least the listed error code at the listed JSON Pointer path. Each invalid case contains exactly one violation. Fixture text is deliberately labelled test data, never product content.
